text: Gather: 4 popular US cleaning products with public disclosures — Clorox Disinfecting Wipes Fresh Scent (Clorox SmartLabel, updated 4/8/2025), OxiClean Versatile Stain Remover (Church & Dwight SDS), Woolite Delicates Laundry Detergent (Reckitt SmartLabel), Mr. Clean Magic Eraser (P&G SDS composition section). 15 new ingredients. 7 graded from PubChem/ECHA C&L via tools/ghs_lookup.py (hexoxyethanol, triethanolamine, BHT, butylphenyl methylpropional, hexyl salicylate, isoeugenol, eugenol), each with its consensus percentages cited and any sub-40% codes noted. 8 recorded unclassified/extrapolated with explicit sourcing notes because they are UVCB/polymers with no PubChem CID (sodium polycarboxylate, the melamine-formaldehyde copolymer, the two BAC-type quats, TEA cocoate, C10-16 pareth, C12-14 alcohols ethoxylated propoxylated, sodium C10-16 alkylbenzenesulfonate) — never an invented grade. Headline finding: butylphenyl methylpropional (Lilial), a CMR 1B fragrance banned in EU cosmetics since 2022, is still disclosed in a US detergent — added as a reclassified entry plus a new reg entry (EU banned / US allowed) noting the SCCS record that the cosmetics ban does not reach household cleaners. Validator: 0 issues. 141 products, 192 ingredients.

Root-cause fix for the duplicate bug that had been hand-fixed five times: the grow lane's dedupe index was keyed raw (.strip().lower()) while its lookup used norm() (punctuation collapsed), so every seed product whose name or brand contains punctuation (P&G, Free & Clear, Multi-Surface) silently re-added itself each run — which is exactly why Clorox Disinfecting Bleach, the one seed with no punctuation, never duplicated. Index normalized in bulk_ingest.py and a permanent `chem_maintain.py --dedupe --fix` guard wired into chem_cron.sh, so duplicates can no longer survive a run. Removed 4 duplicates (137->133). Schema fixes: 3 invalid enum values closed — Bac-Out impact 'sens'->'allerg', and the non-canonical grade dim 'allerg' on Linalool/Geraniol merged into derm:D per the house H317 rule (matching Citral/Limonene/Fragrance). Gather: 4 popular US products with public disclosures — Resolve Heavy Traffic Foam Carpet Cleaner (Reckitt SmartLabel), Krud Kutter Original Cleaner & Degreaser (Rust-Oleum SDS), Weiman Stainless Steel Cleaner & Polish (Weiman ingredient list), LA's Totally Awesome All-Purpose Cleaner (manufacturer MSDS + retail composition — flagged as weaker sourcing, not presented as equivalent). 12 new ingredients, each graded from PubChem/ECHA C&L via tools/ghs_lookup.py where a CID exists, or recorded unclassified with an explicit note where it does not (UVCB/polymer) rather than guessing a grade. Added CMIT regulatory entry: EU leave-on cosmetics ban since 2016, no equivalent US federal restriction in cleaning products. Validator: 0 issues. 137 products, 177 ingredients.

Sifter lane: dedupe pass — removed 4 duplicate products re-added 09-15 (133→129). Closed 15 ingredient-profile gaps from the two newest products (Cascade ActionPacs enzymes/benzotriazole/polymers, Toilet Stamp ethoxylates) with GHS + evidence-level data. Validator: 0 issues. Also profiled Acid Blue 9 (16 gaps total).

Daily maintain (quota gear): dedupe pass — removed 4 exact-duplicate products re-added 09-13 by prior cron run (131->127); renamed two generic 'Dish Soap' entries to brand names (Meliora, The Honest Company). Added 10 honest ingredient profiles to close validator gaps: Yellow 5, PPG-26, Polysorbate 20, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Plant-derived Surfactants (vague-disclosure flag), Sodium Gluconate, Silica (crystalline-dust hazard note), Pumice, Formaldehyde (IARC 1, anchors releaser entries), and the EU-rejected paraformaldehyde releaser. Daily maintain: removed 20 duplicate product entries (4 products each duplicated 5x from prior cron runs — 146→126). Added Murphy Oil Soap (heritage wood cleaner, 1905). Added 1,4-dioxane regulatory entries (NY State 1ppm ban 2023, EU REACH roadmap evaluation) + ingredient profile (IARC 2B carcinogen, common surfactant contaminant). 127 products, 132 ingredients.
Daily gather: added Method Glass Cleaner (mainstream glass cleaner) and The Honest Company Dish Soap (popular clean brand). 142 products.

Daily gather: added Dawn Ultra Dishwashing Liquid (mainstream US product with MIT preservative). Added EU formaldehyde regulatory entries: (1) BPR Decision 2026/599 banning formaldehyde releaser (paraformaldehyde + 2-hydroxypropylamine) for PT6 in-can preservatives; (2) REACH Annex XVII Entry 77 emission limits (0.062-0.080 mg/m³) for indoor articles effective Aug 2026. 136 products, 131 ingredients.

Daily gather: added DMDM Hydantoin regulatory entry (EU requires "releases formaldehyde" label at 10 ppm; US no such requirement) + Zud Heavy Duty Cleanser (powder rust remover, oxalic acid based). 131 products.

Added DIY Mix & Match Solution Lab — pick a surface (degreaser, glass, all-purpose, porcelain/tub, hard-water, carpet), choose safe base ingredients (castile, alcohol, vinegar, baking soda, essential oils...), set ratios with a visual bottle-fill, get vetted starter recipes + mixing rules (never bleach+acid) and a pH cheat sheet.

Gather pass: added Easy-Off Heavy Duty Oven Cleaner (lye + DEGBE glycol-ether solvent) and profiled Diethylene Glycol Monobutyl Ether; added EU amine-restriction context for ethanolamine. 117 products.

Added global regulatory layer — the planet's verdict: which ingredients the EU/UK/Canada/Japan have banned or restricted while the US still allows them, with reasons. Includes catch-up scoreboard, watch list, and Borax as the showcase heritage-vs-EU case.

v2 overhaul — search by health impact (respiratory, reproductive, endocrine, skin, aquatic, cancer, allergen), heritage 'grandma's cupboard' layer, 'once safe, now flagged' reclassified warnings, 110 documented ingredients (20 gaps closed).
